ownerDescription: Create an access code and choose the games each client can run.
name: Client name
error: Your request could not be completed. Please try again.
themeUnavailable: This game’s theme is unavailable. Contact your organiser.
gameUnavailable: This game is unavailable. Contact your organiser.
rotateDescription: A new code replaces the old code and signs out existing sessions.
codeOnce: Copy this code now. It is shown only here; you can generate a new one later.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.
createAlready: This client was already created. Select it below and generate a new code if needed.
codeChanged: A new code is ready. Previous sessions have been signed out.
entryDescription: Enter the six-digit code your organiser gave you. No account registration is needed.
codeFormat: Enter all six digits, including any zeros at the beginning.
invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check all six digits and try again.
sessionExpired: Your access has ended. Enter your current code to continue.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
libraryDescription: Choose a game to open the host screen and welcome your players.
noGames: No games have been assigned to you yet. Contact your organiser.
launchFailed: The game could not be opened. Please try again.
signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
